captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a pop-up tilt-only sunroof cassette assembly. It features a dark, flat rectangular frame housing a translucent grey glass panel. At the front edge of the frame, a thin wind deflector strip is integrated. The glass panel is designed to tilt upward from its rear edge via a revolute hinge located along its front horizontal axis, while the wind deflector simultaneously lifts on its own revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a pop-up tilt-only sunroof cassette with a flat rectangular glass panel and a wind deflector. The glass panel should tilt upward from the rear edge using a revolute hinge at its front, and the wind deflector should lift using a revolute hinge at the front edge of the frame.
captions.factory: The code constructs the sunroof assembly using three primary parts: a base frame, a glass panel, and a wind deflector. The base frame is modeled by performing a boolean cut on a large box using a smaller box to create the open aperture. The glass panel is constructed from a box with rounded external corners, coupled with an inner cut-out representing the semi-transparent glass pane. The wind deflector is modeled as a simple thin rectangular box. Two revolute joints are defined: one connecting the glass panel to the frame at the front edge, and another connecting the wind deflector to the frame, both rotating about the horizontal X-axis.
